explication: SwiftDate is a Swift date-and-time toolkit. Its central workflow parses a string or constructs a date, represents it with a calendar/time-zone/locale region, applies date operations, then compares or formats the result. The repository also documents date enumeration, Codable support, random generation, and time-period management. Parsing and several APIs are evidenced by sampled source; some capability links rely on README descriptions and the file tree, so uncertain call wiring is omitted.
